description: This file defines the PipesClient class within the Aws\Pipes namespace, providing method signatures for interacting with the Amazon EventBridge Pipes service, including operations like createPipe, deletePipe, describePipe, listPipes, startPipe, stopPipe, and tag/untagResource. It serves as a client wrapper for AWS SDK calls.

classes.name: PipesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon EventBridge Pipes service, inheriting from AwsClient, providing methods for managing pipes lifecycle and resource tags.

methods.name: createPipe
methods.description: Creates a new pipe in the Pipes service.

methods.name: createPipeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new pipe in the Pipes service.

methods.name: describePipe
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific pipe.

methods.name: describePipeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific pipe.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
